```go
package slug

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestMake(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		s        string
		max      int
		want     string
	}{
		{
			name: "Happy path with lowercase and hyphens",
			s:    "Hello, World!",
			max:  10,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "No truncation when max is zero",
			s:    "Hello World",
			max:  0,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "No truncation when max is negative",
			s:    "Hello World",
			max:  -5,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "Truncation applied when max is positive",
			s:    "Hello World",
			max:  5,
			want: "hello",
		},
		{
			name: "Empty input string",
			s:    "",
			max:  10,
			want: "",
		},
		{
			name: "Input with only special characters",
			s:    "!@#$ %^&*()",
			max:  10,
			want: "---------",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := Make(tt.s, tt.max); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("Make() = %v, want %v", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello, World!", 10)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Happy path with lowercase and hyphens(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello, World!", 10)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_No truncation when max is zero(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World", 0)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_No truncation when max is negative(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World", -5)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Truncation applied when max is positive(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World", 5)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Empty input string(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("", 10)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Input with only special characters(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("!@#$ %^&*()", 10)
	}
}
```
